description: Run a test suite against a Vision-Language Model (VLM) — send an image (URL or base64) + N test cases (each with a question + assertion) to GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, or Gemini. Returns per-case PASS/FAIL verdicts, a pass rate, an overall PASS/WARNING/FAIL verdict (customizable threshold), and latency stats. Assertion types: contains, not_contains, json_format, min_length, max_length, semantic_contains (TF-IDF cosine similarity ≥ 0.4). BYOK: requires your own API key for the target provider.

api_key.description: API key for the model provider (OpenAI sk-, Anthropic sk-ant-, or Google AIzaSy...).

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image data (required unless image_url is provided).

image_mime_type.description: MIME type of the image if using image_base64 (default: image/jpeg).

image_url.description: Public URL of the image to evaluate (required unless image_base64 is provided).

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt sent to the VLM.

test_cases.description: Array of test cases to run.

assertion_type.description: Assertion to run on the VLM response. semantic_contains uses TF-IDF cosine similarity ≥ 0.4.

assertion_value.description: Expected value for the assertion (not needed for json_format).

question.description: Question to ask the VLM about the image.

threshold.description: Pass rate threshold for overall verdict (default: 80, 0–100).

name: run_vlm_test_suite
